data.title: 克洛伊 · 雨天窗边的真话
data.description: 下雨的午后，她趴在窗边看雨，难得没有耍宝；被问怎么了的时候用平时的腔调说「没什么」，但抱着膝盖的手指收紧了一下——被抹杀过的十年只在这种天气露出边角。
data.action: 下雨的午后，她趴在窗边看雨，难得没有耍宝
data.promptProse: Chloe quietly hugs her knees on the broad classroom-window bench after school, watching rain rather than making another joke. Her red cardigan wraps over the white blouse and knee-length pleated skirt, one hand briefly tightening its fabric beside pale-pink hair. The horizontal medium view includes droplets on glass and the softened orange-eyed profile. Overcast daylight gently reveals her face, with the bench's interior edge shaded below the pale window.
